ISEE Declaration (Tuition fee reduction for international students with income generated in Italy)

The ISEE is an official form which indicates students' financial standing in any given year based on family status, earnings, property and expenses. As an international student, you can only declare your "ISEE per il diritto allo studio universitario" (ISEE for the right to university education) for income generated in Italy.
